preconditions.description: The input S must be a string.
The length of the string S must be between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The return value must be a string.
The return value must be a substring of S.
The return value must be a palindrome.

postconditions.expression: all(len(p) <= len(return_value) for p in [S[i:j+1] for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i, len(S)) if S[i:j+1] == S[i:j+1][::-1]])
postconditions.description: The return value must be the longest palindromic substring in S.

postconditions.expression: all(S[i:j+1] != return_value or i >= S.index(return_value) for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i, len(S)) if S[i:j+1] == S[i:j+1][::-1] and len(S[i:j+1]) == len(return_value))
postconditions.description: In case of multiple palindromic substrings of the same maximum length, the return value must be the one that occurs first in S.
